entries.description: Adds a solver arm (pinning) to a draft.
Lists a draft's arms.
Removes an arm from a draft.
Updates an existing arm's pinning and/or notes.
Grants workspace membership and/or gated-operation grants to a principal (sponsor-only).
Revokes a principal's gated-operation grants (sponsor-only).
Reads the workspace's authority policy.
Creates a new draft in a workspace, optionally seeded from a spec file.
Reads one draft's current document.
Imports SWE-bench rows as a sealed benchmark attached to a draft.
Creates a new workspace directory and its founding-sponsor authority policy.
Resolves and displays a draft's arms, benchmark, and assurance settings.
Lists every draft in a workspace.
Assembles and seals the Matrix once the run's close boundary is reached.
Launches the locked run on the real local venue (authority-gated).
Seals the Run record and transitions the draft to locked (authority-gated).
Runs a disposable rehearsal of the draft's arms on the local venue in a throwaway area; never official evidence, never advances the lifecycle.
Prices a compiled run against the local venue's capabilities, without spending.
Produces the sealed Report and claim package from the closed run's Matrix (authority-gated).
Reads the sealed Matrix as a results document with venue-honesty disclosures.
Resumes an interrupted run, dispatching only outstanding work.
Reads per-cell live status folded from the run journal.
Independently re-derives the Matrix (and, once reported, the Report and claim package) from durable workspace state.
Attaches the bundled sample benchmark to a draft.
Applies a JSON patch to a draft's spec.
